meta.description: Resolves a normalized phone number to the correct Salesforce record with a deterministic search order, resolves converted leads and related Opportunity/application records, never guesses between multiple matches, computes the verification level, and emits a sanitized context object.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =SELECT Id, Name, StageName, IsClosed, OwnerId, CreatedDate FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false AND Id IN (SELECT OpportunityId FROM OpportunityContactRole WHERE ContactId = '{{ $json.record_id }}') ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 10
